Name: Koraidon (Pokemon) - Horse Replacer
Author: Silverinnia
Description:
[center][b][size=3]~ Installation ~
[/size][/b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Download and unzip file
3. Place folder in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
4. Run game with SMAPI[/center]


Horse retexture requested by WolfSnek-Emerald to change the horse into Koraidon from Pokemon Scarlet. Only changes the appearance so it will still make galloping sounds. If you would prefer it to be silent, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13428]Change Horse Sounds[/url].

Miraidon can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20245]here[/url]. Only install one at a time. Miraidon and Koraidon will not work together since they are replacers.

Manifest.Name: Koraidon Horse Replacer
Manifest.Description: CP replacement texture to turn your horse into Koraidon.
